settings.extraNameHintsHelp: Comma or newline separated. These names are replaced with placeholders before any cloud embedding or LLM call — add your own name here, since chat exports label you generically (e.g. "User").
settings.nativeDescription: Stores vectors locally in a SQLite file inside your app data folder. No external service required.
settings.queryExpansionToggleHint: When a character enables query expansion, generate an expanded query with the distill LLM and fuse a second vector search (uses the distill LLM API key).
settings.ragDefaultsBody: Per-character overrides live on the character record (twinSettings.ragTopK, twinSettings.styleSamplesK). When unset, the runtime falls back to topK = 6, styleSamplesK = 3, with both RAG and style few-shot enabled.
settings.rerankerModelHint: Lexical is local and key-free. LLM asks the distill model to rate relevance (uses the distill LLM API key).
settings.rerankerToggleHint: Over-fetches a wider pool and re-scores before keeping the top-K.
settings.resetDialogBody: This deletes the local vectors.sqlite file. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetSuccess: Vector store reset. Reload the page to reinitialise the store.
settings.title: Settings
settings.workerToggleLabel: Auto-start the job worker for this twin

sourceUploader.filesDescription: Text formats (Markdown / CSV / HTML / JSON / source code / .eml / .mbox) are stored as-is. Binary formats (PDF / DOCX / PPTX / EPUB / ODT / ODP) are parsed in the browser; only the extracted text lands in Dexie. Chat exports (ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Slack / Lark / WeChat / DingTalk) and mbox files fan out into one source per conversation.
sourceUploader.gitRepoDescription: Walks recent commits with simple-git and creates one source per commit (subject + body + diff). Desktop only — uses your Tauri filesystem permissions.
sourceUploader.urlDescription: Fetch a web page or article and store its readable text as one source. WeChat / X / YouTube links use dedicated extractors; other pages fall back to readable-text extraction.
sourceUploader.webModeHint: In the browser, cross-origin fetches may be blocked by CORS. The desktop app fetches through a local proxy without this limit.
